# Abdula Adil

> Abdula Adil is an AI Engineer and full-stack developer in Abu Dhabi, UAE, working at Velosi Asset Integrity Ltd. Builds LLM-powered enterprise systems for the industrial and asset-integrity sector: voice AI (Whisper speech-to-text, Kokoro text-to-speech), computer vision that converts P&ID drawings into 3D models, NL-to-SQL over SQL Server, and Python FastAPI AI microservices integrated with ASP.NET Core, Angular and React Native apps.

Also searched as: Abdulla Adil, Abdullah Adil, Abdul Adil.

## Projects

- [VAIL-Plant](https://abdula-adil.vercel.app/projects/plant/): enterprise AI assistant with real-time voice chat and a React Native mobile app
- [P&ID → 3D](https://abdula-adil.vercel.app/projects/pid/): computer-vision pipeline turning piping & instrumentation diagrams into 3D models
- [VAIL ERP — AI](https://abdula-adil.vercel.app/projects/erp/): natural-language querying of live ERP data (Ollama, Semantic Kernel, FastAPI)
- [VAIL-AIPS](https://abdula-adil.vercel.app/projects/aips/): process-safety software (hazard management, compliance, risk tracking)
